issues.title: unsupported claim
issues.text: your documents will stay dry beside this bottle
issues.reason: The copy implies a containment or protective performance outcome (that the bottle prevents moisture from reaching nearby items) which is not supported by the allowed facts. The allowed facts only confirm material, capacity, and lid type. While the text acknowledges leak resistance is unverified, it simultaneously makes an affirmative claim about keeping documents dry, which constitutes an unsupported performance promise.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the claim about keeping documents dry. You may state that the bottle has a screw-top lid, but avoid implying specific protection outcomes for other items.
